note: Hand-written hypotheses that split the strongest existing effects (celebration, gratitude, personal story) into choices a writer can make, plus common LinkedIn advice that had no question yet.

properties.name: own_career_milestone
properties.question: Does the post announce a change or milestone in the author's own career, such as a new job, promotion, work anniversary, or leaving a role?
properties.definition: The author reports a change or milestone in their own job or career path.
properties.yes_example: After four years at the clinic, today is my last day.
properties.no_example: Our team shipped the new billing module this week.
properties.hypothesis: Career news invites congratulations from the author's network.

properties.name: celebrates_someone_else
properties.question: Is the post mainly about celebrating an achievement of a person or team other than the author?
properties.definition: The main subject is another person's or team's success, award, or milestone, not the author's own.
properties.yes_example: Huge congratulations to Priya on defending her PhD today!
properties.no_example: I just defended my PhD today.
properties.hypothesis: Separates celebrating others from self-promotion; both may lift reactions differently.

properties.name: admits_own_mistake
properties.question: Does the author describe a mistake or failure they personally made?
properties.definition: The author admits an error, wrong decision, or failure of their own.
properties.yes_example: I hired too fast and it cost us the team.
properties.hypothesis: Vulnerability is common LinkedIn advice; test it.

properties.name: personal_life_outside_work
properties.question: Does the post mention the author's life outside work, such as family, health, or hobbies?
properties.definition: The post refers to the author's family, health, home life, or personal interests beyond their job.
properties.yes_example: My daughter asked me what I do all day.
properties.no_example: Our quarterly numbers came in today.
properties.hypothesis: Personal context may humanize the author.

properties.name: describes_hardship
properties.question: Does the post describe a hardship such as illness, loss, layoff, or burnout that affected the author or people close to them?
properties.definition: The author recounts a difficult life or career event affecting themselves or someone close.
properties.yes_example: Last year I was laid off two weeks before my wedding.
properties.no_example: Layoffs are rising across the tech sector.

properties.name: asks_for_personal_help
properties.question: Does the author ask readers for help for themselves, such as referrals, a job, or introductions?
properties.definition: The post requests personal help, a job lead, or an introduction for the author.
properties.yes_example: If you know a team hiring product designers, I would love an intro.
properties.no_example: We are hiring product designers, apply here.
properties.hypothesis: Requests for help mobilize the network.

properties.name: welcomes_new_member
properties.question: Does the post welcome a new person to a team, company, or group?
properties.definition: The post introduces and welcomes a newly joined colleague, member, or partner.
properties.yes_example: Please welcome Tom, who joins our design team today.
properties.no_example: Tom has led our design team for five years.

properties.name: farewell
properties.question: Does the post say goodbye to a role, team, place, or person?
properties.definition: The author marks leaving or the departure of someone or something with a farewell.
properties.yes_example: Saying goodbye to the team that taught me everything.
properties.no_example: Excited to start my new role on Monday.

properties.name: names_three_plus_people
properties.question: Does the post name three or more specific people?
properties.definition: At least three distinct individuals are named in the post.
properties.yes_example: Thanks to Ana, Ben, and Chloe for making this happen.
properties.no_example: Thanks to the whole team for making this happen.
properties.hypothesis: Naming people may bring those people and their networks in.

properties.name: opens_in_a_specific_moment
properties.question: Does the first sentence place the reader in a specific moment, giving a time, place, or action that happened?
properties.definition: The opening sentence describes a concrete scene or moment rather than a general statement.
properties.yes_example: At 6am on Tuesday, my phone buzzed with a message from our biggest client.
properties.no_example: Client communication is the key to growth.
properties.hypothesis: Scene openings are common hook advice; test it.

properties.name: opens_with_bold_claim
properties.question: Does the first sentence state a firm opinion or claim on its own line?
properties.definition: The post opens with a one-sentence assertion of the author's view, set apart from what follows.
properties.no_example: I have been thinking about outreach lately and wanted to share some notes.
properties.hypothesis: Bold one-line hooks are common advice; test it.

properties.name: organization_voice
properties.question: Is the post written as an organization speaking, rather than as an individual person?
properties.definition: The post speaks as a company or institution (official announcement style) with no individual's perspective.
properties.yes_example: Acme Corp is pleased to announce our new partnership with Beta Ltd.
properties.no_example: I am so excited that we are partnering with Beta Ltd.
properties.hypothesis: Official-sounding posts may underperform personal ones.

properties.name: generic_advice_without_experience
properties.question: Does the post give advice without tying it to anything the author experienced or did?
properties.definition: The post offers tips or guidance stated in general terms, with no event from the author's own experience.
properties.yes_example: Five tips to improve your resume: keep it to one page...
properties.no_example: When I rewrote my resume last year, cutting it to one page got me three interviews.
properties.hypothesis: Advice underperforms in the data; check whether personal grounding removes the penalty.

properties.name: engagement_bait
properties.question: Does the post ask readers to comment a word, like, or share in order to receive something?
properties.definition: Readers are told to comment a keyword, react, or repost to get a resource or reward.
properties.yes_example: Comment 'GUIDE' and I'll send you the template.
properties.no_example: Here is the template, link below.

properties.name: behind_the_scenes
properties.question: Does the post show how the author's own work or organization operates internally?
properties.definition: The post reveals internal processes, routines, or moments not normally visible from outside.
properties.yes_example: Here is what our Monday planning meeting actually looks like.
properties.no_example: Our product helps teams plan faster.

properties.name: admits_doubt_or_fear
properties.question: Does the author say they felt doubt, fear, or insecurity?
properties.definition: The author states a personal feeling of doubt, fear, nervousness, or insecurity.
properties.yes_example: Honestly, I was terrified before going on stage.
properties.no_example: The talk went well and the audience was great.
properties.hypothesis: Emotional vulnerability is a specific emotion beyond general emotion.

properties.name: reports_own_numeric_result
properties.question: Does the post report a numeric result the author or their team achieved?
properties.definition: The post gives a number that measures an outcome the author or their team accomplished.
properties.yes_example: We grew from 3 to 40 customers in six months.
properties.no_example: Most startups take years to find customers.
properties.hypothesis: Concrete own results may be more credible than general statistics.

properties.name: mentions_duration_of_journey
properties.question: Does the post state how long the author has spent on something, such as years in a field or months on a project?
properties.definition: The post gives a length of time the author has invested in a career, project, or goal.
properties.yes_example: Ten years ago I wrote my first line of code.
properties.no_example: I wrote some code this weekend.
